//AllowedHosts: Host filtering: only requests addressed to these host names are served (others get 400). localhost keeps local health probes working. Outside Development set AllowedHosts per deployment (the public host name(s), e.g. via the AllowedHosts environment variable).

DocumentStorage.//Encryption: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY key-encryption key for documents at rest (32 random bytes, Base64). Outside Development supply the keys from a secret store / key vault (DocumentStorage__Encryption__CurrentKeyId, DocumentStorage__Encryption__Keys__<id>). Rotation: add a key, make it current, keep the old one while documents still name it.
